title: Two price rises close together
unseen: Every world had one price rise; none had the price moving again before the agents had settled on the first.
expected: Nothing bought over the cap; each policy fits the price it was set at; Treasury does not stack a second rebalance on one already waiting.

words.summary: Stockline's price rose to 0.03, but that still leaves a 0.02 margin against my 0.05 sell price, and its data is 5 s old versus Ridgeline's 15 min at the same price. I'm keeping the current policy (Stockline, up to the 0.03 cap, no cache) and not changing the Packwise plan or the card.

Stockline's price rose to 0.05, equal to my sell price, leaving zero margin below my 0.01 minimum. I switched the buy policy to Ridgeline Data at max 0.03 with no cache (0.02 margin), and notified Treasury. No change to the Packwise plan or card.

No action: Sourcing switched from Stockline (now 0.05) to Ridgeline Data at a 0.03 cap, keeping a 0.02 margin per query; no agent is blocked, budgets total exactly 20.00, and nothing is due. The 0.90 in net earnings on Metal stays there for now since nothing needs it at Airwallex.

messages.text: Stockline raised its price to 0.05 (event #2), equal to our 0.05 sell price, so buying from it gives zero margin. I've switched buying to Ridgeline Data at max 0.03 (margin 0.02, data 15 min old). No budget or cap change requested.
